description: Totals for the current project: widget count, page views, completions, conversion percentage, lead count and how many have unsubscribed. Conversion is completions divided by views as a whole percentage; with no views yet it reads 0, which means NO DATA rather than a failure. Completions is not leads — an announcement-bar or an ungated calculator completes without capturing an address. Pass from and to (epoch milliseconds, both) for a date range: the response then also carries that window and the same-length window before it (views, leads, conversions, revenue in cents), plus leads by device and by UTM source. Leads marked bad are excluded from those figures.

project.description: A project id from list_projects. Runs this call in that project instead of the connection default.
